items.title: Nå kommer snøen. Meteorologen advarer: – Alltid noen som tror det er lurt
items.excerpt: Snøen har inntatt Oslo. Nå advarer meteorologen om kaos på veiene.

items.title: Ramponert over natta. Mener området trenger flere parkeringsplasser: – Det var glass overalt
items.excerpt: Frykter flere vil bli rammet grunnet parkeringssituasjonen i området.

items.title: CNN: Demokratene vinner historisk senatsvalg i Mississippi
items.excerpt: Demokraten Scott Colom har vunnet senatsvalget i den tradisjonelt republikanske delstaten Mississippi, ifølge CNNs prognose. Colom slår dermed den sittende republikanske senatoren Cindy Hyde-Smith, melder CNN onsdag kveld. Han blir den første demokraten som representerer Mississippi i Senatet på over 40 år. Colom blir også den første svarte politik

items.title: Sykdomsutbrudd på villaks: – En internasjonal katastrofe
items.excerpt: Fem lakseelver er rammet av et større utbrudd av sykdom.

items.title: Famed ship SS United States sunk off coast of Florida
items.excerpt: Activists unsuccessfully fought for the historic liner to be preserved and turned into a museum, but it will now become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

items.title: What we know as pressure builds on embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
items.excerpt: The billionaire tech executive's future is in question after reports of a second extramarital affair.

items.title: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
items.excerpt: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.

items.title: Iran warns of expanded retaliation as Israel reportedly readies to attack
items.excerpt: Israeli security cabinet orders military to step up preparations for a possible attack on Iran, Israeli media reports.

items.title: Building collapse in Brooklyn kills two, injures more than a dozen
items.excerpt: Rescue crews search for victims as Mayor Mamdani says first responders arrived one minute after emergency call.

items.title: Mother reunites with sons taken under Pinochet regime 40 years ago
items.excerpt: A Chilean mother has finally embraced her sons for the first time in 40 years since they were taken under Pinochet.
